# Packages
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
```

# Load in Data
```{r}
train <- read.csv('train.csv')
```

# Data Processing
## Data Cleaning
Let's take a look at which variables have NA values
```{r}
sapply(names(train), function(col_name) {
  sum(is.na(train[col_name]))
})
```

```{r}
train_clean <- train
train_clean$LotFrontage[is.na(train_clean$LotFrontage)] <- 0 # NAs likely just houses with no street access
train_clean$Alley[is.na(train_clean$Alley)] <- 'NoAlley' # NAs likely just houses with no alley
train_clean <- train_clean[!is.na(train_clean$MasVnrType),] # Only 8 NAs, best to remove
train_clean <- train_clean[!is.na(train_clean$MasVnrArea),] # Only 8 NAs, best to remove
train_clean[train_clean$TotalBsmtSF == 0, c('BsmtQual', 'BsmtCond', 'BsmtExposure', 'BsmtFinType1', 'BsmtFinType2')] <- 'NoBsmt' # Most NAs when TotalBsmtSF == 0
train_clean <- train_clean[!is.na(train_clean$BsmtExposure),] # 1 NA left, best to remove
train_clean <- train_clean[!is.na(train_clean$BsmtFinType2),] # 1 NA left, best to remove
train_clean <- train_clean[!is.na(train_clean$Electrical),] # Only 1 NA, best to remove
train_clean[train_clean$Fireplaces == 0, 'FireplaceQu'] <- 'NoFrplc' # Most NAs when Fireplaces == 0
train_clean[train_clean$GarageArea == 0, c('GarageType', 'GarageYrBlt', 'GarageFinish', 'GarageQual', 'GarageCond')] <- 'NoGarage' # All NAs when GarageArea == 0
train_clean[train_clean$PoolArea == 0, 'PoolQC'] <- 'NoPool' # All NAs when PoolArea == 0
train_clean$Fence[is.na(train_clean$Fence)] <- 'NoFence' # Likely NAs are houses with no fence
train_clean$MiscFeature[is.na(train_clean$MiscFeature)] <- 'NoMisc' # All NAs when MiscVal == 0

sapply(names(train_clean), function(col_name) {
  sum(is.na(train_clean[col_name]))
})
```
